_note: The HUD style (decision 71, work order 169). `measured` is a COPY of what tools/hud_measure.py measures off assets/shared/hud/galaxy_hud.png and doc/briefs/169-mockup-galaxy.png; the smoke test holds the two equal, so edit the artwork or the tool, never this block. Lengths are REFERENCE px (1920x1080) and scale with the window; colours are RGB. `mockup_colony` comes from Data's colony mockup, which is not in the tree (21 MB) — its sha256 is recorded, the tool re-measures it with --colony, and the suite reports rather than checks it. `chosen` holds what nothing in the material shows, each value with the reason it is what it is: those are ours, which under decision 53 means Data's to change.

chosen._font_note: The mockups' face is a squared geometric sans. The tree holds two faces: Aldrich (squared, technical, the display font since 31 August) and pygame's default freesansbold. Aldrich is the closer; parked (169 P3).
chosen._supersample_note: Every block is drawn at 3x its device size and smoothscaled down once, then cached: that is the antialiasing of a slanted or chamfered edge at any resolution. 3 is chosen, not measured against 2 or 4; the edge-width check (smoke 006a) holds the result at three resolutions.
chosen._glow_note: A glow is the edge line blurred by three box passes, the classic approximation of a gaussian: pygame 2.6 has no blur, numpy's cumulative sum is exact and fast.

button._note: The HUD shows every nav button in ONE state. Hover takes the HUD's own brightest lit edge (the TURN button's) and the panel's inner glow as fill; active takes the colony mockup's selected row, the only 'chosen' look in the material; disabled is the normal button at 45 % opacity, a value chosen by eye and not measured. None of the three is measured, all three are named (169 parked, P4).

small_button._note: a small button inside a panel is the action button's shape at half the panel's chamfer, so it reads as the same family and does not compete with the panel's own corner

popup._note: a dialog is a panel lit like the action button, because it is the thing that wants an answer; opaque, as decision 69's fill rule and 'a palette-indexed engine cannot dim' both require

scrollbar._note: the thumb is half the scroll column, centred, as the colony mockup draws it

chosen._text_note: text sizes come from measured cap-height fractions (`measured.text.*.cap`) times the box's height; below 9 device px Aldrich stops being legible, so that is the floor.
chosen._background_note: What a screen draws until Data's background for it arrives (decision 71: one slot per screen, a plain dark placeholder until then). Darker than the panel fill (3, 12, 28) so a panel reads as a panel on it, and the same hue.
chosen._frame_buttons_note: Where the pre-game screens' two frame buttons go, in reference px: the old skin frame's own button bars (assets/shared/skins/default/frame/9slice.json, 1672x941 source scaled to 1920x1080), so no screen's content had to move when the frame went. Left is a slanted button, right the action button.
